name: Sofwave
lead: Sofwave is an ultrasound-based, non-invasive skin-lifting system used in aesthetic medicine for skin laxity, wrinkles, acne scars and cellulite. A 2023 review describes ultrasound devices as delivering energy to dermal and subdermal tissue to cause thermal injury, leading to collagen remodeling and lifting, and lists Sofwave and Ulthera as FDA-cleared systems with clinically significant results for eyebrow, submental and neck lift and fine-line reduction [2].
Unlike RF microneedling, it does not involve needles. The review notes that patient selection and expectation management are important [2].
infobox: Skin laxity, wrinkles, acne scars, cellulite
Described as FDA-cleared in a 2023 review [2]

paras: Per the 2023 review, ultrasound energy causes controlled thermal injury in the dermis and subdermis, prompting collagen remodeling [2]. A 2026 computational modelling paper proposed that effectiveness relies on fibroblast mechanotransduction and examined how GLP-1 receptor agonist use might alter this; it is a simulation, not a clinical trial [3].

Registered Sofwave studies include a 2020 phase 3 study of 45 participants for skin laxity [4], a 20-person 2020 study of submental, neck and eyebrow lift [5], a 60-person 2022 study for acne scars [6], a 2023 60-person study of upper lip and perioral wrinkles [7], and cellulite studies of 69 and 60 participants [8][9]. A 50-person study targeted upper arm laxity [10], a 100-person study of lax facial skin is recruiting [11], and a 2026 lower-face and neck study is not yet recruiting [12]. A 2025 10-person study examines fibroblast stimulation after a single treatment [13]. Outcome data from these registrations are not summarized here.

timeline.event: Skin laxity and submental/neck studies begin [4][5].

card.summary: Needle-free ultrasound skin-lifting system with many registered trials; a 2023 review describes it as FDA-cleared with clinically significant lift results.
card.note: Expectation management is emphasized in the review.

quick.overview:
Sofwave uses ultrasound to heat the dermis, aiming to lift and tighten skin without needles. A 2023 review calls it FDA-cleared.

It has been registered in many studies for laxity, wrinkles, acne scars and cellulite; outcomes are not summarized here.
quick.mechanism: Ultrasound energy creates controlled thermal injury in dermal and subdermal tissue, leading to collagen remodeling.
quick.risks: Side effects are not detailed in the available sources; the review stresses patient selection and managing expectations.
